today.desc_menstrual: Umzimba wakho uyakhulula. Ukuphumula, ukufudumala, kanye nokuzamazama okumnene kukusekela kangcono manje.
today.desc_follicular: Amandla ayakhula. Isikhumba sakho sikhanya kakhulu, ingqondo yakho ibukhali. Isikhathi esihle sokuhlela nokwakha.
today.desc_ovulation: Usekupheleni kwakho. Ukuzethemba kukwisto, isikhumba sikhanya, kanye nokuxhumana kufika ngokwemvelo.
today.desc_luteal: Ukwehla kwe-spidi ukuhlakanipha. Umzimba wakho ulungisa. Hlonipha okudingekayo uzipha isikhathi ngobumnene.
today.desc_unknown: Rekhoda inyanga yakho yokugcina ukuvula izimvo zakho zesiklasi.
today.cta_follicular: Isikhumba sakho sikhanya kakhulu leli sonto. Isikhathi esihle sokubhukisha ukususwa kwezinwele noma unyango lwobuso.
today.cta_ovulation: Isikhumba sakho sikhanya manje. Senzele okona kukhulu ngokunxibelelana nokunaya.
today.countdown_days: Inyanga yakho elandelayo isele izinsuku ezingama-{count}
today.countdown_day: Inyanga yakho elandelayo isele usuku olulodwa
today.skin_note_menstrual: Isikhumba sakho singaba sensitifu ngalesi sikhathi. Gcina imikhuba yakho ibe nhle — hlanza, faka amanzi, ugweme izinto ezisebenzayo njengeretinol noma ama-acid anamandla.
today.skin_note_follicular: Isikhumba sakho siyacwebezela. Lesi isikhathi esihle sokwethula izinto ezisebenzayo njengeVitamin C noma ukususa amaseli ashayo.
today.skin_note_ovulation: Isikhumba sikhanya kakhulu. Amavula angabonakala evulekile — ukuhlanza nzulu noma unyango lobuso kusebenza kahle manje.
today.skin_note_luteal: Ukukhiqizwa kwamafutha kuyanda futhi amabala avela kalula. Sebenzisa isicoci esinobumnene futhi ugweme amakhilimu asindayo.

log.title: tara-s
log.body: Ubehlale azi umzimba wakhe. Le ndawo ingeyakho ukukhumbula.

insights.title: Umzimba wakho ukhuluma ngani.
insights.subtitle: Izinhlelo ezisuselwa kulokho okurekhode.
insights.empty_title: Izinhlelo zakho zizovela lapha uma urekhoda.
insights.need_more_data_body: Rekhoda isiklasi esinye bese i-TARA-S iqala ukubona isinhlelo sakho.
insights.avg_duration: Inyanga yakho ivamile ukuhlela izinsuku ezingama-{days}.
insights.variability_consistent: Iziklasi zakho zibibile kakhulu muva nje.
insights.variability_regular: Iziklasi zakho zilandela umculo omuhle. Umahluko omncane uphila ngokwemvelo.
insights.variability_irregular: Ubude besiklasi sakho buhlukile ngezinsuku ezingama-{days}. Umzimba wakho uyaphendula emhlabeni wakho. Ukugxila ezinhlelweni ngokuhamba kwesikhathi kukuxoxela ngaphezulu kunoma yiziphi izinyanga ezinye.

information.title: Esikwaziyo.
information.subtitle: Ucwaningo olwazisa wonke umbono.
information.disclaimer_body: I-TARA-S yakhiwe phezu kocwaningo olunzulu, futhi sigcina leso cwaningo esimisweni esiphezulu. Kodwa umzimba womuntu wesifazane omuhle ngokwakhe. Inhloso yethu ingokungenela amava okona amahle futhi ukuhamba nawe ezigabeni zemvelo zesiklasi sakho.

privacy.title: Esibambile, nokuthi kungani.
privacy.subtitle: Lokhu kungokwakho. Konke kwakho.
privacy.section_collect_body: Izinsuku zakho. Izimpawu zakho. Akukho okunye. Asidinga indawo yakho, abantu oxhumana nabo, noma imikhuba yakho ngaphandle kwale app.
privacy.section_storage_body: Igcinwe ngokuphepha. Ayabelwananga, ayagaywa, ayanikelwanga muntu, nganoma yisiphi isizathu.
privacy.section_control_body: Thatha konke nawe, noma usicime ngokuphelele. Ukucofa okukodwa ukudawunilowuda konke. Ukucofa okukodwa ukucima konke, ngokupermanente.
privacy.delete_confirm: Lokhu kuzocima konke ngokupermanente. Ngeke kubuyiselwe. Uqinisekile?
privacy.delete_modal_body: Uma sekwenziwe, ngeke kubuyiselwe. Yonke imininingwane, yonke impawu, konke okwabelene nayo lapha kuzoshabalala. Uqinisekile ukuthi ufuna ukukuyeka konke?

onboarding.welcome_body: Ngaphambi kokuqala, imibuzo embalwa ukuthola isiklasi sakho.
onboarding.date_q1_sub: Lokhu kusisiza ukuthola lapho ukhona namuhla esiklasini sakho.
onboarding.date_q2_sub: Izinsuku ezimbili zisisiza ukuthola isiklasi sakho.
onboarding.date_q3_sub: Izinsuku ezintathu futhi singaqala ukubona isinhlelo sakho.
onboarding.ready_sub: I-TARA-S izofunda nawe. Okuninzi orekhoda, kokuninzi ekuqondayo.

inactivity.title: Usekhona?
inactivity.body_before: Sithatha ubumfihlo bakho ngokuqikelela. Uzophuma ngaphakathi
